verdict.rationale: HelixDB documents dense vector indexes and BM25 text indexes in the same engine. The evidence shows these only as separate retrieval primitives. Nothing shows a single hybrid query that fuses vector and keyword/BM25 scores with a fusion ranking such as RRF or weighted scoring, so these are developer building blocks and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can combine dense vector search with keyword or sparse (BM25-style) signals in one hybrid query with fusion ranking

citations.quote: Vector indexes rank node or edge embeddings by distance.
Text indexes provide durable BM25 search over string properties on nodes or edges.

Keeping these retrieval models in one database lets an application work with connected entities, semantically similar content, and exact terms without synchronizing separate graph, vector, and text stores.
